identity.name: Bottom Time
identity.tagline: Built with love for the ocean

logo.notes: Logo text is proportionate to icon height. Approved Feb 12, 2025.

scale.h1_hero: text-lg md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.2] (mobile: one line, desktop: large impact)
scale.caption: text-xs text-slate-400

typography.instructions: Import 'Outfit' from Google Fonts in index.css. Ensure all headings use the 'Outfit' font. The Logo text 'Bottom Time' must be visually proportionate to the 72px Waves icon. Use 'text-5xl md:text-7xl' for the logo text to achieve this.

primary.name: Cyan 400
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key highlights, logo icon

grid_system.features: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 md:gap-12
grid_system.hero: flex flex-col items-center text-center max-w-4xl mx-auto

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-slate-900 font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all hover:scale-105 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-400/20
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-900 text-slate-900 font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all

cards.feature: bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 group
cards.pricing: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden

navigation.wrapper: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800

logo.text: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-none

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise texture on dark backgrounds to prevent banding.

media.icons: Use Lucide-React for all UI icons. Use 'Waves' icon for the logo.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on Cyan-400 backgrounds is Slate-900 (Dark), not White. White on Cyan-400 fails WCAG.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts for everything. Use asymmetry in the features section.
Ensure the Logo text height matches the 72px icon height.
Use the 'Bento' grid for the Discover/Listings section.
Primary buttons must be Cyan-400 with Slate-900 text.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'Outfit' font from Google Fonts. 2. Update tailwind.config.js to include the new font family. 3. Update the primary color in index.css to HSL 189 86% 53%. 4. Refactor the Navbar to use the new Logo specifications. 5. Apply the typography scale globally.
